Job title:  Rehabilitation Consultant - OT/Physio/EP - Orange, NSW 

  Working hours:  Flexible to full time or part time with work form home options 

  Salary:  Excellent pay (based on experience) + Super + Bonus + Incentives  

  Location:  Orange, NSW 

  About the role:  

 Are you a skilled and compassionate professional experienced in the field of rehabilitation? We are seeking a dedicated Rehabilitation Consultant to join our dynamic team at [Company Name]. As a Rehabilitation Consultant, you will play a crucial role in assessing, planning, and coordinating services for individuals seeking rehabilitation support. This full-time position offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package. 

 Responsibilities: 

 
	 Conduct thorough assessments of clients' medical, physical, cognitive, and psychosocial needs to determine their rehabilitation goals and requirements. 
	 Develop comprehensive rehabilitation plans in collaboration with clients, their families, and other healthcare professionals 
	 Coordinate and monitor the implementation of rehabilitation services, including therapy sessions, medical interventions, ensuring continuity of care and adherence to treatment plans. 
	 Provide ongoing support, guidance, and education to clients and their families, empowering them to actively participate in their rehabilitation journey. 
	 Conduct regular evaluations and assessments of clients' progress, adjust treatment plans as necessary, and provide detailed reports to stakeholders. 
	 Stay up to date with the latest research, advancements, and best practices in the field of rehabilitation to enhance the quality of care provided. 
 

  Benefits:  

 
	 Competitive remuneration package, including bonus and incentive schemes and salary packaging options  
	 Ongoing workplace mentoring 
	 Clearly defined career development pathways  
 

  Qualifications  

 
	 Tertiary qualifications in an Allied Health or Health Sciences, or a postgraduate qualification in Rehabilitation Counselling 
	 Clinical knowledge of pathologies 
	 Strong communication skills to build and develop relationships 
	 A passion for injury prevention, return to work, and the associated health benefits  
	 A current drivers' licence and access to their own vehicle 
	  New graduates  are welcome to apply  
 

 If you are interested in this position please click  Apply Now    Apply Now

This is a locum doctor role for a Anaesthetics Consultant at Coffs Harbour in NSW.

### Role Info

We need multiple VMO Locum Anaesthetists for the week: 



1 x Monday 7 September to Friday 11 September 

0800-1800

Note: Plus oncall Friday 11 September 1800-0800 



1 x Monday 7 September to Friday 11 September  

0800-1800



1 x Thursday 10 September and Friday 11 September 

0800-1800



For further questions please contact Belinda Jerrard 66567239

mnclhd-chhc-vmosupport@health.nsw.gov.au 



### Job Description

Remuneration:

• VMO Claims are to be completed and submitted online via VMoney Web per NSW Ministry of Health requirements. 

Note on Rates:

Compensation daily rates inclusive for day, evening, weekend and oncall shifts 

Half day rates paid for half day lists 

 

Allowances: 

• Return airfares from any Australian city, cap of $450 return applicable.

• Accommodation provided for period of stay with the locum required to arrive the evening prior and depart either late the last contracted date evening upon completion of the session or the next morning. (Unable to accommodate Pets.)

• Hire Car ($50 per day car hire cap, all inclusive) 

• Locum VMO’s may prefer to drive and are able to claim reimbursement for kilometers via their VMO Claim. 

• VMO Claims are completed online via V-Money Web, assistance and support provided.

Qualifications Required:  

• Full registration with the NSW Medical Board/ AHPRA as a Specialist - Registration MUST BE IN PLACE.

• Applicable Australian Specialist College Membership. 

• Experience as a VMO ANAES. 

• Demonstrate ability to work and communicate effectively as part of a team and provide leadership of JMO’s.
